newsitem.title: USA: Little Egg Harbor, N.J., says gets no legal bids.
newsitem.headline: Little Egg Harbor, N.J., says gets no legal bids.

text.p: The Board of Education of the Township of Little Egg Harbor, Ocean County, N.J., did not receive "legally acceptable bids" on a $7.16 million school bond series 1997 sale, said Steven Terhune, school business administrator and board secretary, on Tuesday.
Terhune declined to elaborate. He did tell Reuters in a telephone interview that "it is undecided at this point" whether the bonds would be offered for sale again.
